notes.title: After Light Fades Soundtrack Is Out Today!
notes.content: [p]Hey folks,[/p][p]If you've been enjoying the beautiful and serene music of After Light Fades, we're happy to announce that the original soundtrack by award winning composer Angus Barnacle has just released today on Steam![/p][p][/p][p]Get it here with 10% launch discount[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3803360/After_Light_Fades_Soundtrack/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Or if you don't have the game, you can get the game+OST bundle here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55064/After_Light_Fades__OST/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Cheers![/p][p]AL[/p]

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
• Added an additional story scene in the first world, to give more context to the nature spirits’ influence on Alice’s journey (although not a part of the plot, I always intended to add this as a sort of "don't worry if you feel overwhelmed, just take time to let it take shape in your mind" bit of colour-text)
• Fixed a bug where a rock shifting down via a shadow could clip through an Alice-clone

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
-Finally fixed that annoying visual glitch when Alice sits down to enter a level. Turns out it was a code issue - who'd have thought!
-Added "About the Soundtrack" in the menu: notes from composer Angus Barnacle on some influences, inspirations, thoughts and feelings that shaped his work on After Light Fades

notes.content: Fixed some more glitches with control remapping.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content: Fixed a few glitches with Control Remapping save/loading

notes.title: Small Patch: Added Control Remapping
notes.content:
Control Remapping
• Added full remapping system for keyboard and controllers (beta). Find it in Menu > Options > Controls > Remap Controls. Save-loading of your remappings is local - so for example if you remap your PC's controller, then that wont be applied to your Steam Deck (I assume that's the most useful setup but let me know if you have other preferences).

Minor Fixes and Updates
• Fixed it so you can't toggle overhead cam when menu is open.
• Fixed it so you can't toggle skulls window when menu is open (necessary because of control remapping).
• Fixed conflicts between movement and undo, eg if you tried to move while undoing or vice-versa.
• Fixed bug where beetles could use mirrors to teleport outside the level bounds.
• Updated one of the oracle levels that had some redundant puzzle elements.

Level Editor
• Auto-moving types such as beetles and shadow-selves now cant fall into abysses via mirrors.
• Added “blue outline box” while cursoring over cells, so it's easier to see which cell is currently highlighted for editing.

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
• Added overhead cam mode that can be toggled with button press: V on keyboard, L2 on controller
• Removed an unintentional solution in the level “Clearways” that made it too easily solvable

notes.title: Small Patch for Level Editor
notes.content:
In Level Editor:
• fixed a bug where av-clone could be accidentally selected when pressing C on an Alice
• fixed a bug where clicking an object-type would set current tool to draw mode, but wouldn’t update the tool-display to highlight the draw tool
• in Intro Help window, added a link to “getting started” tutorial video

notes.title: Level Editor Beta Testing
notes.content:
Hey folks,

Ahead of the game's release in a few months we've been busy developing a public level editor for you to create and share your own levels!

A Beta version is now ready to go and we'd love some testers. If you'd like to join, connect with us on [url=https://discord.gg/rNJ7hpSWus]our Discord[/url] and let us know you're there for the Beta

The Editor is super easy to use, and you can create levels either just for yourself, or share them on Steam Workshop and browse and play levels made by other players.

Cheers!
AL
